agency.name: California Department of Tax and Fee Administration (CDTFA)

authority.citation: Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code §7360 (Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax Law)

name: Motor Vehicle Fuel Tax (gasoline excise)
notes: A per-gallon excise tax, adjusted each July 1 by the change in the California Consumer Price Index as the statute directs. The rate for July 2025 through June 2026 was $0.612 per gallon. Sales tax on fuel is a separate levy. Revenue collected has not yet been sourced.

rates.applies_to: each gallon of gasoline, July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027

sources.name: CDTFA — Sales Tax Rates for Fuels (Motor Vehicle Fuel rates by period)
